name: Two-Pass GPU Volume Ray Casting for Light Field Displays
aliases: Light field display aware volume rendering
Two-pass rendering for light field displays
definition: A two-pass rendering process for light field displays: first pass generates per-projector views via GPU ray-casting to an FBO; second pass corrects non-linear view and color distortions in 2D image space.
summary: Two-Pass GPU Volume Ray Casting for Light Field Displays is a rendering pipeline that decouples 3D ray-casting from 2D post-processing to correct optical distortions for multi-projector naked-eye displays.
